title.narrative: DIBE 2022-12739 - Real Relief Transferring the Technology of Safepad to empower more women in Uganda

description.narrative:
The company aim to carry through 4 pilot projects based on finished pads in 4 different areas: Wester, Eastern, Central Uganda and Eastern DR Congo. However, a small proportion of fabric and necessary machinery will be included for the production workshop.
The company aim to carry through 3 workshops: 1) production & Training (How to make a safepad) 2) Marketing / Sales (How to make Safepad a sustainable business) 3) Quality Assurance & Quality Control (How to ensure and maintain the high quality standards).
with a positive conclusion on the pilot project, we aim to do a technology transfer of Safepad to Uganda which includes setting up a local production. Real Relief provides on-sota training and video instructions for all processes as well as quality assurance guidance and SOP's
